title: Rest Is History episodes dataset
description: Canonical contract between the Python pipeline (producer) and the TypeScript frontend (consumer). The pipeline emits a JSON document conforming to this schema; the frontend reads it and treats any validation failure as fatal.

version.description: Schema version. Bumped on any breaking change.

generated_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when the pipeline produced this file.

guid.description: Stable RSS GUID. Used as the per-episode file key.

pub_date.description: ISO 8601 timestamp at which the episode was published to the feed.

access.description: public = standard feed; members = Supporting Cast Club-only.

countries.description: Present-day countries the episode is about. Empty array means non-geographic.

year_start.description: Signed year. Negative values are BC (year_start = -44 means 44 BC). No year zero — historians skip from 1 BC (-1) to AD 1 (1), so the value 0 is reserved and should not be used; if an episode genuinely straddles the boundary, set year_start = -1 and year_end = 1.

year_end.description: Signed year. Must satisfy year_end >= year_start (enforced in code; JSON Schema cannot cross-reference siblings).

date_precision.description: Used only for label rendering. The numeric year_start/year_end are always concrete.

topics.description: Free-text topic tags. Controlled vocabulary deferred.

historical_figures.description: Free-text figure names. Controlled vocabulary deferred.

links.description: Listen-out links. All optional; UI shows icons only for keys present.
